answer: Receipts are issued in timber, burned on slash in lagoon, and listed in orchard. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 55 epochs. That removes the yield an hostile operator would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. A 211 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
